description: An Imperial team ready to take on these extraterrestrial challenges :)
summary: Our project provides an interactive heads-up display (HUD) that makes use of NASA data for route optimisation, using an A* path-finding algorithm as our prototype. Curiosity surface imagery and elevation data are parts of the data used to create layered maps. The challenge we currently face is that there is scattered data of the topography, but does not have an organised way to utilise them. Such a device is essential for future astronauts to explore Mars in the shortest time possible. It helps to reduce the risk of each mission and the power consumption for exploration, hence allowing future missions to carry out a more detailed analysis on the surface of Mars.
details: Python is used for algorithm creation, while Javascript is used for improving the aesthetics of our design. It is creative as there is a lack of available maps currently for Mars, and it is important that we bridge the gap by providing a user-friendly integrated HUD. We have considered both the functionality and practicality of our solution, which includes refinement of weights when considering the abrupt altitude changes in the surface of Mars. We hope to see real impact on future astronauts through our project, potentially minimising costs of exploration and increasing our capabilities to navigate the complex terrain.
